They're beneath us!|audio = Moltenwave-8.ogg|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 8 (Formerly, [[Molten Mode|Molten]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Elite Abnormal''' is an enemy that appears on Wave 9 of [[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]] mode, Wave 8 of [[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode, [[Challenge Trials]], [[Badlands II]] and Molten Arena [[PVP]] mode. It also appears in [[The Takeover Event]]. It serves as the first major threat to the mode, appearing as a bulky enemy with a decent defense. It debuts in this wave as a [[boss]] in [[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode. It is a significantly stronger version of the [[Abnormal]], having its health increased massively while walking at the same speed. ==Appearance== The '''Elite Abnormal''', akin to the [[Abnormal]], has a desaturated green skin color with darker green veins running through. It has a muscular body. It wears torn dark shirt with two front pockets and pants. The sleeves and pant legs of these clothes are ripped in half. It also wears greay, spiked braces with chains connected to its sides. ==Strategy== *While the '''Elite Abnormal''' has decent health while also being faster than other enemies with similar purpose, like the [[Normal Boss]] or [[Fallen Squire]]. **Early-game towers with decent DPS, such as the [[Electroshocker]], [[Militant]], [[Golden Cowboy]] or [[Ace Pilot]] can be quite effective against this. **Later on, high DPS towers like the [[Minigunner]], [[Crook Boss]] or [[Hunter]] can kill this with ease. *As it is quite fast, decent early-game towers with stalling capabilities like the [[Freezer]] or [[Electroshocker]] can be quite useful. **Do note that it is significantly harder to slow down on Wave 8, as it is a [[Boss]] enemy on that wave. *While defense dropping towers can be used to drop its defense, as it is quite low this is not necessary. **If used, do note that as it spawns as a [[Boss]] enemy on Wave 8 in [[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode, it can only have its defense dropped through burn or chillness. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} EliteAbnormalStun.gif|Current stun animation (11 December 2024 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1EliteAbnormal.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) DefHacker2EliteAbnormal.png|Overclock variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseEliteAb.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Tower Defense Simulator Roblox Trailer|'''Elite Abnormal''' on a promotional video.
